'''Ion welders''' were tools used for welding during the time of the [[All Worlds Ultimate Swoop Rally]]. An individual used the ion welders to repair the [[Pit Screamers]]'s [[Swoop racing/Legends|swooping]] platform on [[Dantooine]].

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught]]'' {{1st}}
